pathways.preferred_future: Fairness between present and future generations
pathways.preferred_future_ref: UN System Common Principles on Future Generations (2023), principle 2 — “Pursue fairness between present and future generations”

milestones.title: Formal Council adoption of EU Intergenerational Fairness conclusions
milestones.success_looks_like: Conclusions adopted with the youth-check and index commitments intact.
milestones.failure_looks_like: Youth-check or index commitments dropped or watered down in the adopted text.

milestones.title: Fiscal fairness reform evidence review
milestones.success_looks_like: A credible reform package links fiscal sustainability with housing, tax-base, or youth opportunity measures under one generational-fairness frame.
milestones.failure_looks_like: Reforms remain isolated, easily reversed, or framed only as deficit management without youth or future-generation distribution tests.

pathways.preferred_future: Think, plan and act with future generations in mind

milestones.title: UNGA 81 high-level week — Declaration on Future Generations follow-up
milestones.success_looks_like: Named DFG implementation commitments in member-state statements; a secured youth side-event slot.
milestones.failure_looks_like: DFG mentioned only rhetorically with no implementation commitments named.

milestones.title: Budget-cycle check on intergenerational fairness tests
milestones.success_looks_like: At least two jurisdictions publish concrete budget or policy impact tests using intergenerational-fairness language.
milestones.failure_looks_like: Signals remain concentrated in speeches, strategy documents, or non-binding references without implementation machinery.

milestones.title: Future-generations institution durability review
milestones.success_looks_like: A commissioner, parliamentary foresight body, or equivalent institution gains statutory powers, recurring funding, or a formal role in legislative review.
milestones.failure_looks_like: Institutions remain isolated, personality-dependent, or vulnerable to defunding after political turnover.
